strings.All American citizens have fundamental r:
Amerika ɔmanfoɔ nyinaa wɔ kyɛfa titiriw a Mmara Nhyehyɛeɛ (Constitution) ne mmara bɔ ho ban. Kasa ho fawohodie ma Amerikafoɔ tumi ka wɔn adwene a aban mfa ne ho nhyɛ mu. Nyamesom ho fawohodie ma obiara tumi som ne gyidie anaa ɔnsom biara. Nsɛmma ho fawohodie hwɛ sɛ nsɛmmɔfoɔ betumi abɔ amanneɛ a aban nsiw wɔn kwan.

Ɔmanfoɔ nso wɔ kyɛfa sɛ wɔde abisadeɛ bɛkɔ aban anim na wɔahyia asomdwoeɛ mu. Kyɛfa a ɛma wɔbu atɛn pa no bɔ nnipa ho ban fi asotwe a ɛnteɛ ho. Agyapadeɛ ho kyɛfa ma ɔmanfoɔ tumi nya agyapadeɛ de di dwuma. Aba to ho kyɛfa hwɛ sɛ ɔmanfoɔ nyinaa a wɔfata betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ abatoɔ mu. Saa kyɛfa yi fa ɔmanfoɔ nyinaa ho pɛpɛɛpɛ a wɔmfa mmusua, nyamesom, ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa, anaa baabi a wofiri nhwɛ.

Aman pii mmɔ saa kyɛfa titiriw yi ho ban, enti ɛsom bo titiriw wɔ Amerika. Mmara Nhyehyɛeɛ no hyɛ saa kyɛfa yi bɔ, nanso ɛsɛ sɛ ɔmanfoɔ hwɛ yie bɔ ho ban. Supreme Court (Asɛnniidan Kɛseɛ) kyerɛ deɛ saa kyɛfa yi kyerɛ wɔ ɛnnɛ berɛ mu. Abakɔsɛm mu nyinaa, Amerikafoɔ apere sɛ wɔbɛtrɛw saa kyɛfa yi mu ama ɔmanfoɔ nyinaa.

strings.Amendments are formal changes to the Con:
Nsakraeɛ (amendments) yɛ nsesaeɛ a wɔayɛ no ɔkwan a ɛfata so wɔ Mmara Nhyehyɛeɛ no mu, na ɛhia sɛ Congress nkyɛmu abien wɔ mmiɛnsa mu pene so na aman no nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa wɔ anan mu si so dua. Wɔasesa Mmara Nhyehyɛeɛ no mprɛn 27, na ɛkyerɛ sɛdeɛ ɛne berɛ a ɛsesa nam bere a ɛkura ne nnyinasoɔ titiriw mu.

Bill of Rights (Nsakraeɛ 10 a edi kan) bɔ fawohodie titiriw ho ban. Nsakraeɛ a ɛtɔ so 13 no yii nkoasom firii hɔ wɔ 1865 mu. Nsakraeɛ a ɛtɔ so 14, a wɔhyɛɛ no Ɔman Mu Ko no akyi no, hyɛ ahobammɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ne mmara kwan a ɛteɛ bɔ. Nsakraeɛ a ɛtɔ so 15 no bɔɔ mmara tiaa abatoɔ mu nyiyimu a egyina mmusua so. Nsakraeɛ a ɛtɔ so 19 no maa mmaa aba to ho kyɛfa wɔ 1920 mu. Nsakraeɛ a ɛtɔ so 26 no brɛɛ aba to mfeɛ ase kɔɔ 18 wɔ 1971 mu.

Nsakraeɛ nso betumi atrɛw aba to ho kyɛfa mu, asesa sɛdeɛ aban yɛ adwuma, na ayɛ biribi wɔ abakɔsɛm mu nsɛm ho. Nsakraeɛ kwan a ɛware no hwɛ sɛ wɔdwene nsesaeɛ ho yie na ɔman no mu nnipa pii foa so.

strings.American culture is diverse, reflecting:
America amammerɛ yɛ ahodoɔ, na ɛda nnipa pii a wɔafiri wiase nyinaa aba no adi. Wɔbu nneɛma bi a ɛsom bo kɛse, a ɛka ankorankoro ahofadi, ɔmanfo nniso, pɛpɛyɛ, ne hokwan ho. Amerikafo bu ɔkasa ahofadi, nyamesom ahofadi, ne adwene ahofadi. Wɔbu adwumaden ne nkɔsoɔ kɛse. Adwene 'American Dream' no—sɛ obiara betumi ayɛ yie denam adwumaden so—yɛ America nipasu ho ade titiriw.

America amammerɛ ka nnwom, adwinni, nhoma, ne sini a anya wiase nyinaa so nkɛntɛnso ho. Jazz, rock and roll, ne hip-hop firi America. Hollywood ayɛ sini a wiase nyinaa hwɛ. America nhoma mu wɔ akyerɛwfo a wɔagye din te sɛ Mark Twain ne Ernest Hemingway. America aduane da nkɛntɛnso ahodoɔ a ɛfiri atubrafo hɔ adi, a ɛka Italy, China, Mexico, ne aduane foforɔ pii ho.

Afahyɛ te sɛ Independence Day (July 4th), Thanksgiving, ne Memorial Day di America su pa ne n'abakɔsɛm ho afahyɛ. America amammerɛ ahodoɔ no ma ɛyɛ nea ɛkɔ so sesa daa. Amerikafo di wɔn nsonsonoeɛ ho afahyɛ bere a wɔbom yɛ adwuma de pere su pa a wɔn nyinaa wɔ. Sɛ wote America amammerɛ ase a, ɛboa ma wote ɔman no abakɔsɛm ne ne nnɛ ɔmanfo ase.
strings.American independence began with growing:
America fahodie fii ase bere a ntawantawa nyinii wɔ British nsase-foforo dumiɛsa no ne British aban no ntam wɔ 1700s awiei mu. Nsase-foforo no mufo tee nka sɛ wɔregye wɔn tow a ɛnteɛ a wonni ananmusifo wɔ Parliament mu, na eyi de kasa a agye din 'no taxation without representation' (tow biara nni hɔ a ananmusifo nni mu) bae. Nsɛm atitiriw a ɛde fahodie bae no bi ne Boston Tea Party wɔ afe 1773 mu, bere a nsase-foforo no mufo too British tii guu Boston Harbor mu de kyerɛɛ sɛ wɔmpɛ tow no.

Wɔ July 4, 1776 no, Continental Congress a ɛwɔ Philadelphia no gyee Declaration of Independence (Fahodie Dawuro) no too mu, a Thomas Jefferson na ɔkyerɛw dodow no ara. Krataa yi bɔɔ dawuru sɛ nsase-foforo no atew wɔn ho afi Britain ho na ɛkyerɛɛ hokwan atitiriw a ɛne 'nkwa, ahofadi, ne anigye akyidi.' Revolutionary War (Nsakrae Ko) no kɔɔ so fi afe 1775 kosii 1783, na General George Washington na odii Continental Army no anim.

Ako atitiriw no bi ne Lexington ne Concord wɔ afe 1775 ne Yorktown wɔ afe 1781. France boaa Americafo no kɛse. Treaty of Paris (Paris Apam) a ɛbaa afe 1783 mu no gyee America fahodie toom wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so. Ɔko no maa United States bɛyɛɛ ɔman foforo a ɛde ne ho ama ɔmanfo nniso ne ankorankoro hokwan.

Mmara kwan pa (due process) ne kwan a obiara wɔ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ no ho adeɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ mmara nhyehyɛe mu. Amanyɛ Mmara no si so dua sɛ aban ntumi nnye obi nkwa, ne fahodi, anaa n'agyapadeɛ a ɛnnam mmara kwan pa so. Yei kyerɛ sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wodi mmara akwan ne mmara a wɔde asi hɔ no akyi. Mmara kwan pa ho banbɔ ma ɛyɛ sɛ wɔrentumi nkyere obi a ntease biara nni ho anaa wɔrentwe n'aso a wɔnnii n'asɛm pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Nsɛmmɔnedi ho mmara kwan pa no ka kwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔbɛhunu asɛm a wɔde abɔ no kwaadu, kwan a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔnya mmaranimfo, kwan a ɔwɔ sɛ wobedi n'asɛm pɛpɛɛpɛ, ne banbɔ sɛ wɔrenhyɛ no mma ɔnka nsɛm a ɛbɛbɔ ne ho kwaadu. Nsakraeɛ a Ɛtɔ so Anum no ka sɛ wɔrenni obiara nkwa, fahodi, anaa agyapadeɛ a ɛnnam mmara kwan pa so. Nsakraeɛ a Ɛtɔ so Asia no si so dua sɛ obi wɔ kwan sɛ wobedi n'asɛm pɛpɛɛpɛ na ntɛm, a mmaranimfo ka ne ho.

Obi nni fɔ kosi sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ sɛ odi fɔ yɛ nnyinasoɔ titiriw. Aban na ɛsɛ sɛ ɛde adansedeɛ kyerɛ sɛ obi di fɔ a akyinnyeɛ biara nni ho. Nkurɔfo wɔ kwan sɛ wɔbɛkyinnye adansedeɛ a ɛtia wɔn, na mmaranimfo abɔ wɔn ho ban. Saa banbɔ yi fa nnipa a wɔbɔ wɔn nsɛmmɔnedi a ano yɛ den ho kwaadu mpo ho. strings.State governments follow a similar struc:
State aban di nhyehyɛe a ɛte sɛ federal aban no de, a ɛwɔ nnwumayɛ, mmaratoɔ, ne atemmu afã. State biara wɔ Governor (nnwumayɛ), state mmaratoafo bagua (mmaratoɔ), ne state asɛnnibea (atemmu). State aban hwɛ nsɛm te sɛ nhomasua, ɔmanfo ahobammɔ, akwantu, ne yiyedi wɔ wɔn ahye mu.

Mpɔtam aban no bi ne county, kuropɔn, ne township aban. Mayor na mpɛn pii odi kuropɔn aban anim, na commissioners anaa supervisors na wɔhwɛ county aban so. Mpɔtam aban de nnwuma te sɛ apolisifo, ogya ho banbɔ, nsu, efĩ nsu kwan, ne akwan ma. Gyinaesi pii a ɛka da biara da asetena tẽẽ no, wosi wɔ mpɔtam hɔ.

Abusuabɔ a ɛda federal, state, ne mpɔtam aban ntam no, Amammɔbɔ Nhyehyɛe (Constitution) ne federal mmara na ɛkyerɛ. States ntumi nyɛ biribiara a ɛne federal mmara bɔ abira, nanso wɔwɔ ahofadi sɛ wɔbɛdi nsɛm a wɔnnyaa no ansie ammma federal aban no so. Ɔmanfo de wɔn ho hyɛ aban afã nyinaa mu denam aba a wɔto ne ɔmanfo dwumadi so. Mpɔtam aban na mpɛn pii ɔmanfo tumi du wɔn ho ntɛm, na wodi dwuma titiriw wɔ American ka-bi-ma-yɛnte (democracy) mu.

strings.The U.S. Constitution was created in 178:
Wɔyɛɛ U.S. Amanyɔ Nhyehyɛe no wɔ 1787 wɔ Constitutional Convention no ase wɔ Philadelphia. Ananmusifo aduonum anum a wofi aman (states) dumien mu hyiaa sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛw krataa a ɛbɛhyɛ America aban nhyehyɛe ase. Amanyɔ Nhyehyɛe no sii Articles of Confederation no ananmu, efisɛ na ayɛ mmerɛw dodo sɛ ɛbɛdi ɔman foforo no so yiye.

Founding Fathers atitiriw no bi ne George Washington, James Madison, Benjamin Franklin, ne James Wilson. Wɔtaa frɛ Madison "Father of the Constitution" (Amanyɔ Nhyehyɛe no Agya) efisɛ ɔde aban nhyehyɛe ho nsusuwii a emu dɔ baa. Franklin, a na wadi mfe 81, na ɔne ananmusifo no mu panyin, na ɔde nyansa ne nhyiam boaa wɔ nhyiam no nyinaa mu.

Amanyɔ Nhyehyɛe no hyehyɛɛ aban afã abiɛsa a ɛwɔ checks and balances (tumi a ɛhwɛ tumi so) nhyehyɛe. Ɛbɔɔ ankorankoro kyɛfa ho ban nso denam Bill of Rights a wɔde kaa ho wɔ 1791 no so. Wɔasesa Amanyɔ Nhyehyɛe no mprɛ 27, na ɛda so ara yɛ ɔman no mmara a ɛkorɔn sen biara. Aman (states) no penee so wɔ 1788, na efii ase dii dwuma wɔ 1789.

strings.The United States has many powerful symb:
United States wɔ agyiraehyɛde a ɛwɔ tumi pii a ɛgyina hɔ ma ne su pa, n'abakɔsɛm ne n'adwene pa. Amerika Frankaa no wɔ nsensan dumiɛsa a ɛgyina hɔ ma mmerɛ mu nsase a edi kan no ne nsoromma a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔman (state) biara. Kɔkɔɔ gyina hɔ ma akokoduru ne ahoɔden, fitaa gyina hɔ ma bem ne kronkron, na bruu gyina hɔ ma ahwɛyiye, boasetɔ ne atɛntrenee.

Bald Eagle, yɛn ɔman anomaa no, kyerɛ ahoɔden, akokoduru ne ahofadi. Great Seal no wɔ ɔkɔre a ɔkura ngo dua mman ne agyan, a ɛkyerɛ asomdwoe ne ahobammɔ. Statue of Liberty a France de maa no akyɛde wɔ afe 1886 mu no gyina New York Harbor ma ɛgye atubrafo fo na ɛgyina hɔ ma ahofadi ne hokwan.

Liberty Bell a ɛwɔ Philadelphia no kyerɛ Amerika ahofadi ne fahodie. Ɔman Dwom no, 'The Star-Spangled Banner,' a wɔkyerɛwee wɔ afe 1814 mu no, wɔbɔ ansa na ɔman nhyiam ahorow ahyɛ ase. Saa agyiraehyɛde yi ka Amerikafo bom na ɛkae yɛn su pa a yɛn nyinaa kura. Sukuu ahorow da frankaa no adi na wɔka Pledge of Allegiance no. Amerikafo bu saa agyiraehyɛde yi sɛ ɛgyina hɔ ma wɔn ɔman ne n'adwene pa.
strings.The United States has many spectacular n:
United States wɔ abɔde mu nneɛma a ɛyɛ nwonwa pii a ɛda n'asase su ahorow adi. Grand Canyon a ɛwɔ Arizona no yɛ wiase abotan nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ nwonwa paa no mu baako. Niagara Falls a ɛwɔ Canada hye so no yɛ nsuo a ɛtene fi soro a ɛwɔ ahoɔden. Yellowstone a ɛwɔ Wyoming no ne ɔman turo (national park) a edi kan, na nsuo a ɛpue fi asase mu ne nsuo hyew wɔ hɔ.

Great Lakes no ne wiase nsuo pa ɔtare nhyehyɛe a ɛsõ sen biara. Rocky Mountains no tɛtrɛtɛ fa atɔe fam aman no mu. Mississippi Asubɔnten no ne ɔman no asubɔnten a ɛware sen biara, na ɛho hia paa wɔ Amerika abakɔsɛm ne aguadi mu. Appalachian Mountains no fa apuei fam United States. Yosemite National Park a ɛwɔ California no wɔ abotan mmepɔ ne nsuo a ɛtene fi soro.

Wɔhyehyɛɛ ɔman nturo de bɔɔ Amerika abɔde agyapade ho ban maa awo ntoatoaso a ɛreba. National Park Service na ɛhwɛ saa mmeae a wɔbɔ ho ban yi so. Amerikafo ɔpepem pii kɔsra nturo no afe biara de gye wɔn ani, sua ade na wɔhwɛ abɔde fɛ. Nturo no boa ma wɔbɔ mmoa ho ban na wɔyɛ nyansahu mu nhwehwɛmu. Abɔde mu nneɛma a ɛyɛ nwonwa yi ma ɔman no ahohoahoa na ɛka wɔn ne asase no bom. Wobu saa mmeae yi ho ban sɛ asɛyɛde ma awo ntoatoaso a ɛreba.
strings.The United States is a democratic republ:
United States yɛ ɔmanfo nniso republic, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ tumi no wɔ ɔmanfo a wɔpaw ananmusifo sɛ wɔnni ɔman no so no nsam. Ɔmanfo nniso (democracy) gyina nnyinasosɛm a ɛne sɛ nnipa nyinaa yɛ pɛ na wɔn nyinaa wɔ nne wɔ aban gyinaesi mu no so.

Federal nhyehyɛe kyekyɛ tumi ma ɔman aban ne aman (states) aban ahorow. Eyi siw ɔhene biako biara kwan sɛ ɔbɛnya tumi abu so. Ɔman aban no hwɛ nsɛm a ɛka ɔman no nyinaa, na aman (states) no hwɛ mpɔtam nsɛm. Saa nhyehyɛe yi ma biakoyɛ ne nsonsonoe nyinaa tumi kɔ so wɔ ɔman no mu.

Amerika ɔmanfo nniso gyina abatow a ɛwɔ ahofadi na ɛteɛ, nsɛmma mu ahofadi, tumi mu mpaapaemu, ne ankorankoro hokwan ho ahobammɔ so. Ɔmanfo de wɔn ho hyɛ mu denam aba a wɔtow, jury mu som, ne ɔman dwumadi ahorow mu a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ so. Ɔmanfo nniso a ɛyɛ den hwehwɛ ɔmanfo a wonim nsɛm a wɔte wɔn hokwan ne wɔn asɛyɛde ase. Constitution no bɔ saa ɔmanfo nniso nnyinasosɛm yi ho ban, na wobetumi asesa mu denam kwan tenten bi so nko ara.

Asɛyɛde ka kwan a wɔde ma no ho. Ɛyɛ ɔman mma asɛde sɛ wodi mmara a ɛfa obiara ho pɛpɛɛpɛ no so. Towtua ma sika ma aban nnwuma te sɛ sukuu, akwan, ɔman ho bammɔ, ne mmoa nhyehyɛe. Sɛ wɔfrɛ wo na wotena jury so a, ɛma asɛnni yɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ na wo mfɛfo kuw bi di atɛntrenee.

Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔman mma to aba wɔ abatow mu na ama wɔate wɔn nne na akannifo abu wɔn ho akontaa. Sɛ wosua nsɛm ne wɔn a wɔrepere dibea ho ade a, ɛboa ma wo to aba a wunim nea woreyɛ. Ɔman mma betumi ayɛ adwuma kwa wɔ wɔn mpɔtam na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔman kuw ahorow mu. Sɛ wobu afoforo kwan ne wɔn agyapade a, ɛho hia ma ɔman a ɛyɛ adwuma yiye.

Awofo wɔ asɛyɛde sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn mma. Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔman mma hwɛ abɔde so yiye ma awo ntoatoaso a ɛreba. Nnipa pii gye di sɛ ɔman mma nso wɔ asɛyɛde sɛ wɔte Mmara Nhyehyɛe (Constitution) no ne wɔn kwan ase. Saa asɛyɛde yi boa ma ɔmanfo nniso (democracy) a ɛyɛ den a ɛbɔ obiara kwan ho ban no kɔ so. Sɛ ɔman mma di saa asɛyɛde yi so a, aban yɛ adwuma yiye na mpɔtam nyinaa yɛ yiye.
